ImageDescription.value: A vertical panorama of Starship SN16 spacecraft taken on 5 September 2021 at SpaceX's Starbase spaceport, which at the time was intended to fly after Starship SN15. However, as of January 2022, the prototype is cancelled and waiting for recycling. Both of its forward and aft flap pairs are closed, with cables and piping seen running in the middle of the spacecraft. Welding seams of steel sections can be seen very clearly, and machines surrounding the spacecraft demonstrate the size of its height.

Artist.value: Lars Plougmann from United States
